name: generate-image-speaker-event
description: Génère un visuel de communication pour annoncer un talk (1 speaker) à une conférence
prompt: I would like to create an image from the template image available in this file %TEMPLATE% integrating these elements: - replace 'Speaker name' by %NAME% - replace 'Talk title' by %TITLE%. Please center this title and use 2 lines at maximum. - integrate the target conference name %CONFERENCE% (and replace the yellow square by the logo of the conference from the %CONF_PHOTO% file if provided). - replace the white square by the speaker photo from this %PHOTO% file if provided. Please don't modify the name of the speaker, the conference name, and the title of the talk.
